name: proto
description: Protobuf serialization and gRPC server/client for inter-service communication and pipeline data contracts

grpcPort.description: Port for standalone gRPC server. If not set, gRPC services share the Express HTTP port via Connect protocol.

standalone.description: Run gRPC server on a separate HTTP/2 port (required for native gRPC clients like Python grpcio)

timeout.description: Default timeout for gRPC calls in milliseconds
